version_sensitive_claims: Axon Framework 4 annotated Saga API differs from Axon Framework 5 Workflows and migration path.
Camunda 7 and 8 worker API and BPMN extensions differ; Camunda 8 compensation handlers may run without a defined global order.
Temporal requires replay-compatible workflow changes or suitable Worker Versioning, rather than automatic code pinning in all configurations.
Eventuate Tram DSL and transport/storage integration depend on module and version.
staleness_risks: Code examples are illustrative and were not compiled against project dependencies.
Timeouts, retry limits, workflow engines and TCC reservation semantics require validation in the target domain.
